call_points.text: Top line expected to rise 7-10% over the next three quarters on higher yarn prices, with no volume growth.
Margins expected to expand 15-20% quarter-on-quarter for the next two to three quarters on better spreads.
Exports to China rose from 2-3% to 10-12% in the last quarter; Bangladesh remains the largest export market.
No forex hedging book is kept; the Q4 mark-to-market loss should reverse this quarter if the rupee stays stable.
Cotton import duty remains a long-standing industry demand; management expects some government action in the next couple of months.
Management declined to disclose cotton inventory coverage, saying only that it covers most of the year's needs by end-March.
Proposed solar power plant investment is expected to save power cost by about 12-15% in the long term.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹636.78 Cr, net profit ₹32.76 Cr.
Sportking India reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹636.8 Cr and announced a ₹1,000 Cr greenfield expansion in Odisha.
Sportking India Limited shared the audio recording link for its earnings call held on May 19, 2026, discussing Q4FY26 performance.

Sportking India's Q4FY26 earnings call guided FY27 revenue at ₹2,700-2,800 Cr, said the ₹1,000 Cr Odisha greenfield project would start commercial operations in Q3FY27, and noted cotton yarn spreads above $1.
On June 3, 2026, Sportking India updated that the SCOD for its solar power supply project is extended to on or before June 10, 2026.
Sportking India Limited rescheduled its Earnings Call for the Second Quarter and Half Year ended 30th September 2026 to Friday, 30th October 2026 at 5:30 P.M. (IST).
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹781.05 Cr (+24.5% YoY), net profit ₹96.36 Cr (+240.9% YoY).
Sportking reported Q2FY27 standalone revenue of ₹781.05 Cr and PAT of ₹96.36 Cr, alongside announcing a major greenfield expansion in Odisha.
